```lean
intro x y
cases (le_total x y) with h1 h2
· have h3 : 0 ≤ x := le_refl x
  have h4 : 0 ≤ y := le_refl y
  apply h₂.1 (Ici 0) x y h3 h4
· have h5 : 0 ≤ -y := neg_le_zero.1 h2
  have h6 : 0 ≤ -x := neg_le_zero.1 h1
  apply h₂.1 (Ici 0) (-y) (-x) h5 h6
  exact h₁ (-x)
  exact h₁ (-y)
  rw [h₁, h₁]
  exact le_antisymm_iff.1 (le_trans (le_zero_neg h2) (le_zero_neg h1))
```
